scientific_limitations: Standard unit-tube Euclidean torus, \(R>1\), coprime \(1\le p<q\). No claim for perturbed curves, other winding regimes, or topological invariance. Costa (1990) establishes the cubic/existence window; new scope is exact root count and multiplicity. Costa 1990 is an earlier publication of unspecified release day; exact 1998-03-06 is the first precisely verified public posting date among inspected sources, not an assertion Costa was later. Historical priority may be incomplete.
title: Complete torsion-zero phase diagram for meridional-dominant torus knots
